items.text: There was discussion on whether or not there should be a certain number of years between how often applicants can apply for the same grant. The Agency Attorney pointed out that this has not been a problem in the past as we have not previously seen an influx of applicants. Director Neuterman also spoke on the topic and explained that it would be up to the agency members to establish the number of years. There were specific years suggested, such as 5 for the Beautification Grant and 10 for the Paint Grant. It was then suggested by Director Neuterman that the board vote on this particular item and then have further discussion regarding regulations on how often a resident can apply for Paint and Beautification Grants. Agency Member Brown will not have a hard time approving this grant, but he would like to see some time in between when applicants can put in for the same grants.
